caption:
OpenAI has announced a $5M grant program dedicated to funding independent research on how generative AI affects teens.

As conversational AI becomes integrated into daily study and social habits, researchers will examine its long-term impact on adolescent development, safety, and well-being.

Why independent research matters: external studies provide neutral data that could shape future safety guardrails and tech regulations.
